policy: Invoke the pinned application Mach-O directly. Verify absolute path, executable format, SHA256 and exact CLI version before discovery and around every model invocation through environment verification. An application update blocks this condition; never silently substitute a PATH executable or shell launcher.
credentials: Copy the existing auth.json to a temporary private HOME only; never log or modify the source credentials. Delete the temporary HOME on close or failed setup.
models_cache: Do not inherit the old CLI model cache. Validate the requested model and reasoning effort through the isolated application CLI discovery.
